5.
(1)  The management, control and administration of
the Corporation shall, subject to the provisions of this Act
and rule that may be made under section 6, vest in a Council
of Management (hereinafter referred to as “the Council”).
(2) The first Council of the Corporation shall consist of
the members of the Council of the Association holding office
on the day preceding the date of commencement of this Act.

6.
